privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your data, protected
privacy.description: Your trust matters. Here's how we protect your data.
privacy.dataCollectionDesc: At Krishi Maitri, we collect information to provide better services to our farmers. This includes information you give us (like your name, phone number, and farm location) and information we get from your use of our services (like weather data for your specific region).
privacy.howWeUseDesc: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, protect and improve our services, and to develop new ones. For example, your location helps our AI Assistant provide hyper-local crop suggestions and weather alerts.
privacy.dataSecurityDesc: We work hard to protect Krishi Maitri and our users from unauthorized access to or unauthorized alteration, disclosure or destruction of information we hold. We use state-of-the-art encryption to keep your data private and safe.
privacy.transparencyChoiceDesc: People have different privacy concerns. Our goal is to be clear about what information we collect, so that you can make meaningful choices about how it is used. You can always request to delete your data from our systems.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Our agreement with you
terms.description: Please read these terms carefully before using our services.
terms.acceptanceDesc: By accessing and using Krishi Maitri, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree to all of these terms, do not use our services.
terms.userResponsibilitiesDesc: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to provide accurate and complete information when using our platform.
terms.prohibitedConductDesc: You agree not to use Krishi Maitri for any unlawful purpose or in any way that interrupts, damages, or impairs the service. Misuse of our AI tools or weather data is strictly prohibited.
terms.limitationLiabilityDesc: While we strive to provide the most accurate AI insights and weather forecasts, Krishi Maitri is not liable for any losses resulting from farming decisions based on our data. Nature is unpredictable, and our tools are meant to assist, not replace, expert judgement.
